headline: A 2004 executive order concerning the United States-Mexico Border Health Commission.
what_it_does: This order deals with the United States-Mexico Border Health Commission, a joint body of the two countries that works on health issues along their shared border. No summary was provided, so the order's specific instructions, such as who serves on or leads the U.S. side of the commission, cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials involved with the U.S. side of the commission
who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets rules for how the U.S. government takes part in the commission, but the details are not available here.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 21, 2004; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
